title: Lucky Gold Gourd & Pink Crystal Necklace
storyHtml:
The wu lu gourd — an age-old emblem of luck and protection — traced in pavé crystal around a glowing pink stone, with a tiny crystal drifting on the chain. A small charm to carry good fortune close.

Jewelry that marks your every becoming.
